lines.text: What if budgeting apps made us feel supported, instead of stressed?
Money is already stressful. Traditional budgeting tools can make it worse.
Introducing Keel. A personal finance concept I designed to make managing money feel simpler, calmer, and more human.
Instead of your balance, see how long you're covered.
Check how a purchase affects your financial outlook before spending.
Understand your spending in days, not overwhelming numbers or red warnings.
Build savings goals, track your progress, and see how each decision shapes your future.
Explore different financial scenarios before making a commitment.
Because better decisions start with clarity.
I designed a motion system where every interaction feels intentional, fluid, and reassuring.
Supported by an accessible design system, custom animations, and a functional React prototype.
Explore my case study and live demo.
